order_date: Date when the order was placed
delivery_date: Scheduled or expected delivery date for the order
component_id: Unique identifier for the component being ordered
component_name: Name or description of the component
cost_per_unit: Cost of each individual unit of the component
supplier_name: Name of the supplier providing the components
supplier_region: Geographic region where the supplier is located
geopolitical_risk: Assessment of geopolitical risks associated with the supplier's location
avg_quality_score: Average quality rating or score for the supplier's components
is_critical: Indicator of whether the component is critical to operations (e.g., boolean)
region: Geographic region for delivery or operations
delivered_on_time: Flag indicating if the delivery was on time (e.g., yes/no or boolean)
shipping_cost: Cost associated with shipping the order
weather_event: Record of any weather-related events impacting the order
defect_rate: Percentage or rate of defective units in the order
